question: Rank expected loss rates on equipment loans by asset type, worst first.

joel.note: Written before any ABS loss data was shown.

tranche.ranking: Agriculture = high, Construction = high, Transportation/Logistics = moderate (agriculture and construction tied, trucks better)

data: See abs-2026-10.md. Trucks lose 4-6x more than ag/construction pools at the same vintage and age (2023 vintage: DTRT 4.11% vs JDOT 0.68% and CNH 0.76% CNL at ~36 months). Agriculture vs construction not separable: neither JDOT nor CNH splits losses by equipment type.

result.joel: Trucks worst: supported. Construction worse than agriculture: not testable.
result.tranche: Trucking (Transportation/Logistics, moderate) scored better than agriculture (high): contradicted.
